Department Resource Get Department Lite
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/departments/lite/:id

Retrieves the department based on the specified ID

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
int32
REQUIRED

Unique identifier for the department

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

Department ID

name
string
REQUIRED

Department name

idpId
int64

Identity provider (IdP) ID. This field is not applicable to the Lite API.

comments
string

Additional information about this department. This field is not applicable to the Lite API.

deleted
boolean

List of deleted departments

Default value: false
